tree.heading: Authority to Use.—
tree.text: The Secretary may use one-step turnkey selection procedures for the purpose of entering into contracts for construction projects.

tree.heading: Definitions.—
tree.text: In this section, the following definitions apply:

children.text: The term “one-step turnkey selection procedures” means procedures used for the selection of a contractor on the basis of price and other evaluation criteria to perform, in accordance with the provisions of a firm fixed-price contract, both the design and construction of a facility using performance specifications supplied by the Secretary.
The term “construction” includes the construction, procurement, development, conversion, or extension of any facility.
The term “facility” means a building, structure, or other improvement to real property.

notes.text: Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 677 of this title as this section.
